save:failure.source:
path.write_bytes(b'KEY 42\n')
db=call(LoadDictionary,uri)
db.set('KEY','not an integer',HEX)
before=path.read_bytes()
rejects(DriverException,lambda:call(SaveDictionary,db))
assert path.read_bytes()==before and not list(path.parent.glob('.spell-db-*'))
db=call(LoadDictionary,uri)
for key,value in [('#lost',1),('NONFINITE',float('nan')),('NESTED',{'bad':float('inf')}),('OBJECT',object())]:
    db[key]=value
    rejects(DriverException,lambda:call(SaveDictionary,db))
    assert path.read_bytes()==before and not list(path.parent.glob('.spell-db-*'))
    del db[key]
cyclic=[]
cyclic.append(cyclic)
db['CYCLE']=cyclic
rejects(DriverException,lambda:call(SaveDictionary,db))
assert path.read_bytes()==before
del db['CYCLE']
path.chmod(0o400)
try: rejects(DriverException,lambda:call(SaveDictionary,db))
finally: path.chmod(0o600)
assert path.read_bytes()==before
rejects(SyntaxException,lambda:call(SaveDictionary,db,'extra'))
path.unlink()
rejects(DriverException,lambda:call(SaveDictionary,db))
assert not path.exists()
os.mkfifo(path)
rejects(DriverException,lambda:call(SaveDictionary,db))
assert not path.is_file() and path.exists()
path.unlink()
target=path.parent/'symlink-target'
target.write_bytes(b'PRESERVE 42\n')
path.symlink_to(target)
rejects(DriverException,lambda:call(SaveDictionary,db))
assert path.is_symlink() and target.read_bytes()==b'PRESERVE 42\n'
path.unlink()
path.mkdir()
rejects(DriverException,lambda:call(SaveDictionary,db))
assert path.is_dir()
path.rmdir()

scope.qualified: LRM pp81-84, Examples143-148 and the four user database operation subsections, using original configured usr:// flat-file databases.
scope.creation: Exclusive create preserves both existing file bytes and cached unsaved values; invalid paths/arity and unwritable directories fail. Real native failure prompts prove alternate-name retry and abort.
scope.saving: Serialize before publication; write a same-directory temporary file, preserve original mode, fsync the new file and atomically replace the existing file. Missing or read-only storage and serialization failures preserve prior bytes and clean the temporary file. This is not a multiwriter transaction or directory-fsync crash-durability claim.
scope.round_trip: UTF-8 literal strings/containers preserve quotes, backslashes and internal whitespace; binary width and exact top-level absolute/relative TIME are serialized without global display-format dependence. Comment-like keys, cyclic/custom values and nonfinite floats are rejected before replacement.
scope.open: Full database-formats section remains open: legacy 035 spelling, non-string file keys, nested TIME/custom value serialization and broad database backends are not claimed. Configured SCDB read-only semantics remain a separate tranche.
scope.distribution: Exact development overlay identities; installed wheel RECORD is superseded for these three modules. Fresh integrated wheel and complete release qualification are separate.
